To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a novel method for the rapid detection of drug resistance mutations in HIV-infected patients using a combination of RT-PCR and sequencing.
we have developed an expert program that couples efficient genetic sequencing of HIV with an expert program, which recommends antiviral drug regimens based on the current literature.
the Customized Treatment Strategies (CTS) program is the first expert system for HIV treatment that is able to incorporate genetic information from the patient.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a computerized expert system for the management of HIV patients.
the application of an expert system to the management of patients infected with the human immunodeficiency virus.
the application of an expert system to the management of HIV infection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in general, the use of an antiviral agent that is active against a virus that is resistant to another antiviral agent does not lead to the selection of resistant virus.
the use of an expert system to manage HIV-infected patients is a useful tool that can be applied to clinical trials as well as to individual patient treatment.
the use of the expert system, CTSHIV, coupled to the sequencing of the HIV pol-gene, provides a useful tool for the selection of antiretroviral drug regimens in HIV infected individuals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expert system is useful in the management of patients infected with drug-resistant strains of HIV.
this project is the first to combine a rule-based expert system with genetic sequencing to provide a comprehensive analysis of HIV-infected patient's drug resistance.
the CTSHIV software is a useful tool in HIV management.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to develop an expert system that can be used to guide treatment decisions for patients with drug-resistant HIV.
it is feasible to use an expert system to guide the selection of antiretroviral therapy.
the combination of genetic sequencing and an expert system is an effective way to identify the best drug regimens for patients infected with HIV.
